nonGoals: No new stateRef, milestone or persistence; captions are not stateRefs.

story.purpose: Give two silent post-arrival draft chapters their voice on existing player actions and existing signed anchors: the ship the player rebuilds is the ship that reports the player, and the brackets come off the embodied voice for good inside these beats.
story.emotionalBefore: Private rebuilding — grief-tinged labor at a filed-closed wreck, the world indifferent, the work its own company; and a silent checklist at the controls, pure procedure with no interiority.
story.emotionalAfter: Chosen visibility — every restored system made the worker more detectable and the last part went in anyway; then deliberate departure answered not with pursuit or absolution but with a row in a table, and a query that does not close.
story.intendedAmbiguity: Whether the attention is procedural or personal; whether the ship's returning systems are being watched or welcomed back; what exactly the worker holds that is not a designation; and whether an open query is a threat, a bookmark, or a door. None of these is resolved here.
nonNegotiableCanon: After the first bare line the embodied voice does not return to parenthetical grammar; the unchanged entry caption is the chapter's last parenthesis inside the locked beats.
Regulation headers carry no first person.
The typed name is the A8 payoff: it is proven retained and never printed, quoted or attached here.
The Authority's answer to the refusal is a reserved payoff and is deliberately absent from these beats.
The consequence stack is an automated handshake noticing a hull, never the refusal, the tree, or the worker's conduct.
The two-word reply stays two words and is not decorated.
The WRECK RELAY header lines attribute restored systems to the hull; the wreck relay prop's beacon is dark during these beats and no line may imply otherwise.
Every line survives both readings: the worker narrative and the hidden pillar, with neither confirmed nor broken.

The registry query addresses a hull, never a person: every regulation line in the ch8 consequence stack files against an unscheduled hull logged destroyed, and no line in it may address, accuse, or name the worker, and no future line may address the designation query to the worker, the voice, or any person; a line that does collapses the timelessness protection and must return to the owner before it ships.

The draw-call, shader-program and GPU-memory numbers above are DELTA ceilings over the shipped baseline, derived from the production lock's ruling that GPU, draw, shader and memory limits are unchanged because the runtime surface is copy-only: at most zero added draw calls, at most zero added shader programs, and at most one added megabyte. Stage edges queue CAPTIONS ONLY — stage commits, receipts, score variant changes, anchor activations and objective transitions all stay real-time and are never delayed by the queue. The queue drops at close on the calibration receipt, with one exception: M6 may not drop. If M6 is unfired or mid-reveal when the calibration receipt lands, the M7 mini-cadence ANCHOR becomes max(t_calibrationReceipt, t_M6 + revealSeconds(M6)), so the whole four-row ch7 exit table shifts with it and the D9 hold still carries every line. Amendment lineage: draft-v3 (repair loop iteration 1, defect vd-01) superseded draft-v2 and changed only the L2 and L3 trigger bindings and the terms they force; draft-v4 (repair loop iteration 2, defect vd-04) supersedes draft-v3 and changes only the canonical verification route and the terms it forces. All twenty-one new strings and the one owner-approved changed string, both ch7 tables, the ch8 exit-window table, the guidance section, the variants, the performance block and the score block are carried unchanged.

Paced ladder (named constants, joining the frozen named-constant set under the same implementation terms — relationships and values frozen, triggers solved by the ladder formula and never by latch reordering): CH8_L1_MIN_SLOT_SECONDS = 4.5 and CH8_L2_MIN_SLOT_SECONDS = 3.0. L1 is unchanged at the first stable dwelled surface-flight state. L2 fires at l2DueAt = max(t_L1 + revealSeconds(L1), min(t_L1 + CH8_L1_MIN_SLOT_SECONDS, t_phaseEdge)), the formula frozen in the L2 due-time criterion; the bare min() form recorded before draft-v5 is superseded. L3 fires at max(t_phaseEdge, t_L2 + CH8_L2_MIN_SLOT_SECONDS) and only if that moment is strictly before the first deep_space observation. Every trigger reads unprotected state only.

The accelerator t_phaseEdge is the live raw spaceFlight phase edge from 'surface' to any non-surface value with controlMode 'flight', observed across consecutive director ticks. It is a caption accelerator and nothing else, and it is clamped by the reveal guard in the l2DueAt formula so it can never advance a line past a preceding line's reveal completion: no score event, no objective, no camera event and no persistence attaches to it in this amendment.

Drop rule: any L-line still unfired when the deep_space fact lands is dropped for that run. Nothing queues, defers or spills into the frozen exit window; L4 fires at +0.0 s unconditionally; if the exit lands during L3's reveal the frozen exit-window table wins and the truncation is authored. Drops and truncations are authored fast-path degradations, asserted in tests — the movie-path drop and the fast-manual truncation alike — and the full three-line experience is the ordered-ignition pace guarantee.

Seeding semantics: all three L latches are edge-triggered and seeded at beat entry. On an entry whose phase is already non-surface — a mid-flight snapshot restore — L1, L2 and L3 seed as consumed, with no replay and no catch-up burst. The pristine ch8-launch deep link boots on the pad with phase 'surface' and plays the full ladder.

SUPERSEDED IN draft-v5 by ruling R1, retained so the record cannot drift: this criterion previously recorded a single authored exception to the no-mid-reveal-overwrite law, permitting a phase-edge acceleration to interrupt L1 mid-reveal. That exception is retired. It is replaced by the read-dwell allowance and the l2DueAt formula recorded above, under which no reveal is ever cut by player or system cause. The no-cascade property still holds and is still asserted: L3 never interrupts L2, guaranteed by CH8_L2_MIN_SLOT_SECONDS being at least L2's reveal plus its read time.

Canonical route and measured-margin guarantee (ordered-ignition). THE CANONICAL ROUTE IS ORDERED-IGNITION: enter the beat seated, on a pristine deep link, at the LOW quality tier; hold all input until L2 becomes due at l2DueAt, which lands at about entry plus 8 s, with the standing control igniting at about entry plus 10 s; then commit [SPACE] and sustain [W] through the atmosphere boundary. On this route L2's cause is the timer, not the phase edge, and L3 fires at the phase edge with its full measured post-edge air. The margin is t_deepSpace minus (t_L3 + 1.98 s), reported per run; a measured margin under the 0.3 s floor is flagged back to the triad rather than passed silently. The dramaturgical basis is recorded because it is the reason this route is canonical and not merely convenient: the ladder is order-then-act, and 'hold it.' must precede the hold. Routes where the player ignites before L2's timer fires do not fail — they join the authored-degradation family governed by the drop rule, alongside the movie-path drop. The [SPACE]-only literal route carries no margin obligation at all; it is retained as a ladder-order and once-only check.

L2 due-time formula (ruling R1, defect F1a): l2DueAt = max(t_L1 + revealSeconds(L1), min(t_L1 + CH8_L1_MIN_SLOT_SECONDS, t_phaseEdge)). revealSeconds is derived at runtime from the frozen string's own character length multiplied by the 34 ms per character reveal rate; it is never hardcoded, so a string edit can never silently outrun its own protection. The effect is that the phase edge may pull L2 earlier than its timer slot but can never pull it earlier than L1's reveal completion.

The authored-interruption exception RETIRES as a mid-reveal law and narrows to a read-dwell allowance (ruling R1). A player-caused phase edge may shorten L1's post-reveal dwell from 1.3 s to as little as 0 s; it may never cut any reveal. No reveal is ever cut, by system cause or player cause, with the single contracted exception of the drop or truncation that the exit fact imposes under the drop rule. The earlier framing of this as an exception to the no-mid-reveal-overwrite law is superseded: there is no longer any mid-reveal exception in this contract.

On the POTATO tier the assertion is the drop, not the render: the tier-dependent fast exit is handled by the drop rule with no special case. Attribution stated honestly per ux-13: no POTATO baseline exists to compare against, so pre-existence is not proven by evidence; the mechanism — tier-dependent pacing crossing the dwell threshold — is unrelated to any code this run mutated, which is why the pre-existing conclusion is very likely right, and the wording says so rather than claiming more, so POTATO evidence asserts that L3 dropped and that order, once-only and the exit-window table are unaffected.
